Opposite Pa  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner : Mr.Amarendra Kumar, Advocate  For the Opposite Party : Mr.Chandra Sen Prasad Singh, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 6 23-03-2026 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/34 and other sections of the IPC and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Petitioner is husband of opposite party no.2 and is in job in Indian Air Force and posted in Chandigarh.

By filing supplementary affidavit, it is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that till date petitioner has paid Rs.60,600/- to opposite party no.2 by way of arrears of maintenance and is regularly paying interim maintenance of Rs.7000/- per month to opposite party no.2 vide order dated 19.9.2025, passed by the Family Court, Ara.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.29559 of 2025(6) dt.23-03-2026 4.
Considering the aforesaid facts of the case, prayer for bail of this petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within eight weeks from today, let this petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Bhojpur at Ara in Mahila Police Station Case No. 61/2024, subject to the conditions laid down under section 482 of the Uttam Tiwari vs The State Of Bihar on 23 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118459213/
1 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
 (Prabhat Kumar Singh, J)
